spans.s: शट a. (f. टा) Sour, acid.
शट a. (f. टा) Sour, acid.
शटा f. The clotted hair of an ascetic. Cf. जटा, सटा.
शाट m. 1. A garment in general; 2. a petticoat.
सट n. 1. An ascetic’s matted hair; 2. a mane, Sis.i.47; 3. bristles of a boar, विध्यंतमुद्धतसटाः प्रतिहंतुमीषुः R.ix.60; 4. a crest.
सटा f. 1. An ascetic’s matted hair; 2. a mane, Sis.i.47; 3. bristles of a boar, विध्यंतमुद्धतसटाः प्रतिहंतुमीषुः R.ix.60; 4. a crest.
शाटी f. 1. A garment in general; 2. a petticoat.
शाटक m.n. Cloth, garment.
सट्टक n. A minor species of drama in Prākṛt, e.g. कर्पूरमंजरी.
षट्क (I) a. (f. ट्का) Six-fold.
षट्क (II) n. An aggregate of six, e.g. अथ निरुक्ते पूर्वषट्कप्रारंभः.
षट्क (I) a. (f. ट्का) Six-fold.
षट्कर्ण (I) a. heard by six ears, i.e. by three persons, e.g. षट्कर्णो भिद्यते मंत्रः.
षट्कर्ण (II) m. A sort of lute.

षट्कर्मन् n. 1. the six duties enjoined to a Brāhmaṇa, (they are- अध्यापनमध्ययनं यजनं याजनं तथा । दानं प्रतिग्रहश्चैव षट् कर्नाण्यग्रजन्मनः M.x.75); 2. the six acts allowable to a Brāhmaṇa for livelihood; 3. the six acts belonging to the practice of Yoga (viz., धौति, वस्ती, नेती, त्राटक, नौलिक and कपालभाती); 4. the six acts that may be performed by magic; (they are- शांति, वश्य, स्तंभन, द्वेष, उच्चाटन and मारण).
षट्कोण n. 1. a hexagon; 2. the thunderbolt of Indra.
षट्चक्र n. the six mystical circles of the body.
षट्चत्वारिंशत् f. forty-six.
षट्चरण m. 1. a bee; 2. a locust; 3. a louse.
षट्त्रिंश a. the thirty-sixth.
षट्त्रिंशत् f. thirty-six.
षट्पंचाशत् f. fifty-six.
षट्पद m. 1. a bee, न हि प्रफुल्लं सहकारमेत्य वृक्षांतरं कांक्षति षट्पदाली R.vi.69, vii.27, K.S.v.9; 2. a louse.
षट्पद˚अतिथि m. the mango tree.
षट्पद˚आनंदवर्धन m. the Aśoka tree.
षट्पद˚ज्य a. having bees for a string (as a bow), प्रायश्चापं न वहति भयान्मन्मथः षट्पदज्यम् Megh.ii.10.
षट्पद˚प्रिय m. the Nāgakesara tree.
षट्पदी f. 1. a louse; 2. a female bee; 3. a stanza consisting of six lines.

षट्प्रज्ञ m. 1. a sage who is acquainted with the four objects of human life (पुरुषार्थ), with the nature of the world and with the nature of the supreme soul, (धर्मार्थकाममोक्षेषु लोकतत्त्वार्थयोरपि । षट्सु प्रज्ञा तु यस्यासौ षट्प्रज्ञः परिकीर्तितः); 2. a lustful man.
षट्षष्टि f. sixty-six.
षट्सप्तति f. seventy-six.
षाट् ind. A vocative particle.
सट् (I) vi. 1P (pres. सटति) To form a part.
सट् (II) vt. 10U (pres. साटयति-ते) To show, to manifest.
सट्ट् vi. 10U (pres. सट्टयति-ते) 1. To kill, to injure; 2. to be strong; 3. to give; 4. to dwell.
साट् vt. 10U (pres. साटयति-ते) To make visible, to manifest, to show.
षाट्कौषिक a. (f. की) Enveloped in six sheaths.
षाट्कौषिक a. (f. की) Enveloped in six sheaths.
सटा-अंक m. a lion.
सट्वा f. 1. A kind of bird; 2. a musical instrument.
साटोप a. (f. पा) 1. Puffed up with pride; 2. consequential.(साटोपम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘arrogantly, proudly.’)
साटोप a. (f. पा) 1. Puffed up with pride; 2. consequential.(साटोपम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘arrogantly, proudly.’)
